checks.detail: load_zemax_file('https://www.thorlabs.com/_sd.cfm?fileName=20565-S03.zmx&partNumber=MAP051950-A') -> ValueError: Failed to read Zemax file.. With outbound network available, Thorlabs answers this URL with a 1313-byte HTML page rather than the .zmx payload.
checks.name: the_tutorials_remote_zmx_url_is_not_a_usable_source

checks.detail: RMS spot radius falls monotonically from 0.001134 mm at the nearest object (360 mm) to 0.000911 mm at the farthest (440 mm), at all 33 samples. image_solve() removes the defocus at each step, so what is left is aberration versus conjugate ratio -- and a doublet corrected for infinity must improve as the object recedes.
checks.name: refocused_residual_falls_monotonically_as_the_object_recedes

checks.detail: the solved image distance falls from 54.7483 to 53.2423 mm, as the conjugate equation requires
checks.name: image_distance_shortens_as_the_object_recedes

checks.detail: max |f*(1/s' + 1/s - 1/f)| = 4.997e-16 over all 33 object positions, with s measured from P1 (which paraxial.P1() reports relative to SURFACE 1) and s' from P2 (which paraxial.P2() reports relative to the IMAGE SURFACE). Mixing those two reference planes up is what produced a 16-61% error on the first attempt.
checks.name: the_gaussian_conjugate_equation_holds_exactly_from_the_principal_planes

demonstrates: load_zemax_file(url) for a remote .zmx (blocked upstream), Optic.updater.set_thickness(value, surface_number=0) to move the object plane, Optic.image_solve(), and a through-focus RMS spot sweep.
notes: The tutorial's own artifact could not be used: thorlabs.com answers the documented .zmx URL with HTML. Even when a vendor URL works, a repository test must not depend on a third-party server -- record the prescription instead. Genuine vendor-authored .zmx parsing therefore remains unverified here and in t08.
title: Thorlabs Catalogue
